notizie.titolo: US Stock Market Today: S&P 500 Futures Nudge Higher On Jobs Strength Fed Uncertainty
notizie.breve: The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Monday, Nov, 9 2026 US stocks are set for a mildly positive open, with sentiment driven almost entirely by a stronger than expected October labor report. Non farm payrolls rose 165,000 in October and the unemployment rate edged down to 4.1%, while average hourly earnings advanced 0.4% month over month and 3.1% year over year.
